title: WaitlistOfferNotifiedV1
description: Outbox event (spec 11 §5.1) emitted when a deadline-bound waitlist offer is sent to a customer. Drives the customer-facing 'a spot opened up' notification carrying the accept/decline deadline. Carries only opaque ids and the customer's chosen notification channel (Inv-12); no PII payload, secrets, or transcript text.

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.offer.notified.v1' for this contract.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (the enrollment id).

offer_id.description: Stable id of the waitlist_offers row offered to the customer.

enrollment_id.description: Stable id of the originating waitlist_enrollments row.

customer_ref.description: Opaque tenant-scoped customer reference; never raw contact details (Inv-12).

notification_channel.description: Customer's chosen delivery channel for the offer notification.

offer_expires_at.description: Deadline by which the customer must accept; the offer auto-expires afterward.

slot_start_at.description: Start time of the matched slot being offered.
